convention: A meaning group is `same` only if EVERY member shown expresses one and the same sense. A group whose members are individually defensible but merge two distinct senses (the granularity-many-to-many case) is `different`, and the reason says so. `unsure` is used when the entry shown is grammatical apparatus, a bare cross-reference, or narrowed by a parenthetical in a way the card cannot resolve.
